# Retail portfolio (IFRS 9) (`retail-portfolio` v1)

A retail portfolio segment: exposure and expected credit loss by IFRS 9 stage, and delinquency.

**Group:** Retail banking · **Mnemonic:** `RPF` · **Identifiers:** `RPF-…` in `portfolioId`

Open one with `RPF <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: retail-portfolio
version: 1
description: "A retail portfolio segment: exposure and expected credit loss by IFRS 9 stage, and delinquency."
match: { kind: retail-portfolio, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Retail banking · Retail portfolio (IFRS 9), id: $.portfolioId }
strip:
  - { label: Portfolio, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Exposure, bind: $.exposure, fmt: compact }
  - { label: ECL, bind: $.ecl, fmt: compact, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Coverage, bind: $.coverage, fmt: pct2 }
  - { label: "30+ DPD rate", bind: $.dpd30, fmt: pct2 }
panels:
  - id: stages
    kind: table
    title: By IFRS 9 stage
    key: F2
    rows: $.stages
    columns:
      - { label: Stage, bind: "@.stage" }
      - { label: Exposure, bind: "@.exposure", fmt: compact, total: true }
      - { label: PD (12m), bind: "@.pd", fmt: pct2 }
      - { label: LGD, bind: "@.lgd", fmt: pct0 }
      - { label: ECL, bind: "@.ecl", fmt: compact, total: true }
  - id: delinquency
    kind: line
    title: "30+ days past due rate"
    area: right
    rows: $.delinquency
    x: month
    y: rate
    fmt: pct2
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.legalEntity, 'legal-entity')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
